title: 全民饥荒：SSS级天赋酿酒师_柠蓝浅夏_第6章 感谢老铁救我狗命！
content_zh:
起初他以为是夜风骤降，但紧接着，他绝望地发现，自己浑身上下的汗毛正一根根倒竖起来，冷汗瞬间浸透了脊背！

蓝星上那些无聊的短视频科普突然在脑海中炸回荡：

半夜突然惊醒，若是周围毫无异常，千万别动，继续装睡，那多半是家里进人了。

在这片吃人的荒原，这个时间段，进的绝对不会是人！

许默死死屏住呼吸，眼角余光疯狂扫视着篝火摇曳的阴影。

周围什么都没有。

就在他以为神经紧绷出现错觉的刹那。

吼——！！！

一声震耳欲聋的恐怖兽吼从远处的黑暗深处轰然炸响，连带着身下的土地都隐隐发颤！

许默瞳孔骤缩！

蜂后！有情况！

他在脑海中疯狂催动精神指令，试图联系那只虫子。

毫无回应。

一片死寂。

许默愣了一瞬，视线猛地扫向属性面板。

【蜂蜜花酿】附加的“触角”状态图标，赫然已经灰暗！

八小时的有效时间，竟然在沉睡中悄无声息地耗尽了！

该死。

许默咬紧牙关，手忙脚乱地抓起石斧，蹑手蹑脚地缩进山窝最深处的岩石夹角。

黑暗中仿佛有无数双眼睛在窥视，草丛里窸窸窣窣的声音像附骨之疽般萦绕不散。

幽蓝色的光幕突然亮起。

区域聊天频道正在疯狂滚动。

【编号8847231：听见没？！刚才那声吼！草！我感觉它就在我避难所外边转悠！】

【编号1234901：救命啊……我的篝火快灭了，我不敢出去捡柴！理智快掉光了！】

【编号9902341：这到底是个什么世界啊，我要回家，我不想死了……】

许默盯着屏幕，喉结微动，迅速在光屏上敲击。

【许默：兽吼距离很远，别自己吓自己，看好火把别出声。】

发出这行字，许默将后脑勺紧紧贴着冰冷的岩壁。

那吼声确实远，他这里暂时还算安全，可周遭那若有若无的诡异动静从未停歇，那种如芒在背的恐怖感死死攥着他的心脏。

漫长的煎熬中，第一缕微光终于撕裂了厚重的黑幕。

天亮了。

公屏里的哀嚎声非但没有减弱，反而越发绝望。

一夜未眠，加上极度的恐惧，无数人的理智值已经逼近红线。

许默不知道理智值一旦清零，迎接他们的会是怎样恐怖的下场。

他扫向系统顶端的刺眼数据。

【当前区域编号：9527幸存人数：2213】

昨天还是三千多！

仅仅是第二个夜晚，又没了一千多人！

照这个速度，连头七都过不去，这片区域的人类就会彻底死绝！

许默很清楚，在这该死的世界里，孤狼死得最快。

活人越多，能产出的资源和交易价值才越大，必须要有人抱团，必须要团结！

可在这种绝境下，怎么可能会有人团结？

许默眼底精光微闪，心中猛地生出一个疯狂的念头。

他切进交易大厅，直接将物品栏里的存货疯狂倾泻。

上架五十份花酿，统一定价，50幸存点/份！

整个区域频道瞬间炸锅。

【我尼玛！救了命了，神了啊！】

【感谢！感谢老铁救我狗命！】

【这东西卖这么贵，物价赶上我们魔都了，我买不起要死的啦！】

私聊频道的提示音几乎是在同一时间疯狂响起。

那个阴魂不散的编号36454160直接跳了出来。

【编号36454160：大佬你疯了？！你昨天卖我可不是这个价！那可是保命神器，你这是搞恶性竞争啊！】

字里行间透着浓浓的幽怨和难以置信。

许默神色毫无波澜，快速回复过去。

【许默：你当时没幸存点，我们是以物换物，各取所需，不需要可以互相拉黑。】

对面瞬间陷入了语塞，连一个标点符号都没再发过来。

仅仅几分钟。

五十份花酿被一抢而空！

清脆的系统提示音连成一片，许默的幸存点余额如同坐火箭般暴涨，瞬间突破数百大关！

【幸存点累积达到阈值，系统商店已解锁！】

耀眼的金色光幕在视网膜上展开。

没有任何犹豫，许默的目光直接锁定了生存类商品栏。

白光频闪间，破烂的衣物被一套硬挺的绿色野战装备取代。

战术背心、护膝、高筒军靴一应俱全。

腰间挂着一把泛着寒光的精钢折叠军刀，背上别着多功能战术手斧。

【面板刷新：当前负重上限提升至20！】

许默抽出那把精钢军刀，锋利的刀刃在旁边的石壁上狠狠划下第二道深刻的白痕，记录下这第二天。

装备升级带来的安全感并没有让他彻底膨胀。

收起军刀，他沿着昨夜蜂后精神共享的记忆路线，一头扎进浓雾未散的荒原。

半小时后。

一片低矮的灌木林出现在视野尽头，枝叶间挂满了红得发紫的饱满果实，几片宽大的叶子兜着清澈的露水。

许默双手如飞，疯狂采摘。

【获得：新鲜的浆果×50】

【获得：纯净水×10】

接下来的整整一个上午，他挥舞着战术手斧，在荒原边缘疯狂收割。

木材、石块等基础材料被塞进扩容后的背包。

烈日渐渐升至中天。

高强度的劳作让许默的肌肉泛起一阵酸痛，深深的疲惫感席卷全身。

他在附近找了一处凹陷的土坑，扯下几片比人还大的宽阔树叶盖在身上，准备稍作休整。

四周渐渐升腾起诡异的浓雾，气温悄然下降。

沙……沙……

极其细微的脚步声，突兀地碾过枯枝，穿透迷雾，径直刺入许默的耳膜！

和昨晚一样，他一个机灵翻身而起！

有东西过来了。

许默的睡意瞬间蒸发。

没有任何犹豫，他一把扯下腰间的【蜂蜜花酿】，用牙咬开木塞，仰头将剩下的大半瓶猛灌入喉！

熟悉的精神连接再次在大脑中轰然炸开。

蜂后，来！

他在心底发出一声嘶吼。

“我的王……感受到您的召唤，我来侍奉您了……”

高空中传来沉闷的嗡鸣，巨大的复眼穿透迷雾疾驰而来。

借着蜂后的高空视角，许默终于看清了那个逐渐逼近的轮廓。

那是一头体型堪比成年猎豹的灰褐色野兽！

它正压低着身子，在浓雾中左右嗅探。

锋利的獠牙外翻，暗黄色的竖瞳里闪烁着令人胆寒的凶光。

只要不动，这大雾应该能掩护过去。

许默紧紧握住军刀，屏住呼吸。

“嘶！王！逃！”

脑海中，蜂后突然发出一声极其尖锐的预警。

高空俯冲带起的狂风，猛地将浓雾撕开一道缺口！

那股独属于蜂后和许默之间精神链接的特殊信息素，随着狂风瞬间扩散！

糟了！

野兽猛地顿住脚步，鼻翼疯狂翕动。

它竟然通过半空中的蜂后，硬生生在空气中嗅到了许默掩盖不住的味道！

那对暗黄色的竖瞳瞬间死死盯住了许默隐藏的那片巨叶！

吼——！！！

腥风扑面。

庞大的兽影猛地蹬碎地面的枯木，直直撞破迷雾，向着许默的藏身之处疯狂扑杀而来！

content_en:
At first he thought it was the sudden drop in the night wind, but then he desperately found that the hairs all over his body were standing on end, and cold sweat soaked his back instantly!

Those boring short popular science videos on Blue Star suddenly echoed in my mind:

If you suddenly wake up in the middle of the night, if there is nothing unusual around you, don't move and continue to pretend to be asleep. It's probably because someone has entered the house.

In this man-eating wasteland, at this time, the person who enters will definitely not be a human!

Xu Mo held his breath and frantically scanned the swaying shadows of the bonfire with the corner of his eye.

There is nothing around.

Just when he thought his nerves were tense and he was experiencing an illusion.

roar--!!!

A deafening and terrifying beast roar exploded from the depths of darkness in the distance, causing the ground beneath him to tremble faintly!

Xu Mo's pupils shrank suddenly!

Queen bee!There is a situation!

He frantically activated spiritual commands in his mind, trying to contact the insect.

No response.

There was dead silence.

Xu Mo was stunned for a moment and glanced at the attribute panel.

[Honey Flower Brewing] The additional "tentacles" status icon is suddenly gray!

The eight hours of effective time were quietly exhausted in his deep sleep!

Damn it.

Xu Mo gritted his teeth, hurriedly grabbed the stone ax, and crept into the corner of the deepest rock in the nest.

There seemed to be countless pairs of eyes peeping in the darkness, and the rustling sounds in the grass lingered like gangrene in the bones.

A faint blue light curtain suddenly lit up.

The regional chat channel is scrolling like crazy.

[No. 8847231: Did you hear that?!That roar just now!Grass!I feel like it's hanging around outside my shelter!】

[Number 1234901: Help... My bonfire is about to go out, and I dare not go out to collect firewood!My sanity is almost gone!】

[No. 9902341: What kind of world is this? I want to go home. I don’t want to die...]

Xu Mo stared at the screen, his Adam's apple twitching slightly, and he quickly tapped on the light screen.

[Xu Mo: The beast's roar is far away, don't scare yourself, watch the torch and don't make any sound.】

After saying these words, Xu Mo pressed the back of his head against the cold rock wall.

The roar was indeed far away, and he was still safe here for the time being, but the vague and strange movements around him never stopped, and the feeling of terror like a ray of light on his back gripped his heart.

In the long ordeal, the first glimmer of light finally tore through the thick black curtain.

It's dawn.

The wailing in the public screen not only did not weaken, but became more desperate.

After a sleepless night and extreme fear, the sanity of countless people has approached the red line.

Xu Mo didn't know what kind of horrific end would happen to them once their sanity was cleared.

He glanced at the glaring data at the top of the system.

[Current area number: 9527 Number of survivors: 2213]

Yesterday it was more than 3,000!

On just the second night, more than a thousand people were gone!

At this rate, even the first seven people cannot get through, and the human race in this area will be completely extinct!

Xu Mo knew very well that in this damn world, lone wolves die the fastest.

The more living people there are, the greater the resources and transaction value that can be produced. Someone must stick together and unite!

But in this desperate situation, how can anyone be united?

Xu Mo's eyes flashed slightly, and a crazy idea suddenly came to his mind.

He cut into the trading hall and poured out the inventory in the inventory.

Fifty portions of flower brew are on the shelves, unified pricing, 50 survival points per portion!

The entire regional channel exploded instantly.

【I'm crazy!It saved my life, it was amazing!】

【grateful!Thank you Lao Tie for saving my dog’s life!】

[This thing is so expensive, the price has caught up with our magic city, I can't afford it to death!】

The notification tone of the private chat channel sounded crazily almost at the same time.

The lingering number 36454160 jumped out directly.

[Number 36454160: Boss, are you crazy?!This is not the price you sold me for yesterday!That is a life-saving weapon. You are engaging in vicious competition!】

There is deep resentment and disbelief between the lines.

Xu Mo looked unperturbed and quickly replied.

[Xu Mo: You had no chance of survival at that time. We were exchanging things for things. We each got what we needed. We could block each other if we didn’t need it.】

The other person was speechless for a moment and didn't even send a single punctuation mark.

Just a few minutes.

Fifty servings of flower brew were sold out in one go!

There were crisp system prompts in succession, and Xu Mo's survival point balance skyrocketed like a rocket, breaking through hundreds in an instant!

[The accumulation of survival points has reached the threshold, and the system store has been unlocked!】

A dazzling golden light curtain unfolded on the retina.

Without any hesitation, Xu Mo's eyes directly locked on the survival goods column.

As the white light flashed, the tattered clothes were replaced by a set of stiff green field equipment.

Tactical vests, knee pads, and high military boots are all available.

A stainless steel folding saber with a cold light hung on his waist, and a multifunctional tactical hand ax was pinned to his back.

[Panel refresh: The current upper limit of load capacity has been increased to 20!】

Xu Mo pulled out the stainless steel saber, and the sharp blade scratched a second deep white mark on the stone wall next to it, recording the next day.

The sense of security brought by the equipment upgrade did not completely inflate him.

Putting away his saber, he followed the memory path shared by the Queen Bee's spirit last night and plunged into the wasteland where the thick fog still lingered.

Half an hour later.

A low shrub appeared at the end of the field of vision. The branches and leaves were covered with plump red and purple fruits, and a few wide leaves carried clear dew.

Xu Mo's hands were flying and he was picking wildly.

[Obtain: Fresh Berries ×50]

[Obtain: Purified Water ×10]

For the entire morning that followed, he wielded a tactical hand ax and harvested wildly on the edge of the wasteland.

Basic materials such as wood and stones are stuffed into the expanded backpack.

The scorching sun gradually rose to the sky.

The high-intensity work caused Xu Mo's muscles to feel sore, and a deep feeling of fatigue swept through his body.

He found a sunken pit nearby, pulled off a few broad leaves that were larger than a person, and covered himself with them, preparing to rest for a while.

A strange thick fog gradually rose around, and the temperature quietly dropped.

Sand...sand...

The extremely faint footsteps suddenly ran over dead branches, penetrated the fog, and pierced Xu Mo's eardrums!

Just like last night, he suddenly stood up!

Something is coming.

Xu Mo's sleepiness evaporated instantly.

Without any hesitation, he pulled off the [Honey Flower Brewing] from his waist, bit open the cork with his teeth, raised his head and poured the remaining half of the bottle into his throat!

The familiar mental connection exploded in the brain again.

Queen bee, come!

He roared in his heart.

"My king... I feel your call, and I have come to serve you..."

There was a dull buzzing high in the sky, and huge compound eyes rushed through the fog.

Using the queen bee's high-altitude perspective, Xu Mo finally saw the approaching outline clearly.

It was a gray-brown beast comparable in size to an adult cheetah!

It was lowering its body, sniffing left and right in the thick fog.

The sharp fangs were turned outwards, and the dark yellow vertical pupils flashed with a frightening ferocious light.

As long as we don't move, the heavy fog should be able to cover us.

Xu Mo held the saber tightly and held his breath.

"His! King! Run away!"

In her mind, the queen bee suddenly issued an extremely sharp warning.

The strong wind caused by the high-altitude dive suddenly tore a gap in the thick fog!

The special pheromone that belongs to the spiritual connection between the queen bee and Xu Mo spread instantly with the strong wind!

Oops!

The beast suddenly stopped and its nostrils twitched wildly.

It actually passed the queen bee in mid-air and smelled the scent in the air that Xu Mo couldn't hide!

The pair of dark yellow vertical pupils instantly stared at the giant leaf Xu Mo was hiding!

roar--!!!

The fishy wind blows against my face.

The huge beast shadow violently smashed the dead wood on the ground, broke through the fog, and rushed toward Xu Mo's hiding place!
